title: gossipframe
summary: Gossip is complete as a flow: SMSG_GOSSIP_MESSAGE decode (options + quest rows), NPC-text fetch with $N/$C macro expansion, greeting panel art, NPC name title, selectable option rows with coded-option guard and route classification, quest rows forking to details vs completion by dialog-status icon (QuestFrameUiLaw.GreetingAction), Goodbye and close buttons. 10/11 opcodes hit; the missing CMSG_GOSSIP_CLOSE is a non-gap - Benilla's own ui_gossip.rs states 'there is no CMSG_GOSSIP_CLOSE' and sends nothing either.

openItems.text: No per-row icons: gossip options lack the GOSSIP_ICON-typed textures (Gossip/Vendor/Taxi/Trainer/Binder/Tabard/BattleMaster GossipIcon) and quest rows lack ActiveQuestIcon/AvailableQuestIcon - MSUI renders '> text' / '[level] title' plain rows
